summary_markdown:
The participants discussed improving the method for tracking router connectivity status. It was proposed to replace the current ping mechanism with an MQTT-based system. This new approach would track connection status by recording `connected_on` and `disconnected_on` timestamps, allowing a null value in the second field to indicate an online status.

Separately, discussions covered technical tasks related to ClickHouse logging (ensuring logs are written) and API development for a specific service. A plan was made to follow up on these items with relevant team members.
decisions: Replace router ping tracking with MQTT-based status updates
Implement connection status using `connected_on` and `disconnected_on` fields
action_items: Follow up on ClickHouse logging setup to ensure logs are written
Review API development progress for the service mentioned by 'p1'
Provide feedback/updates regarding UI tasks (e.g., creating a company/customer)
